maddeler.e:
استوءوا (form X)
# اِسْتَوْءَوْا (istawʔaw) /is.taw.ʔaw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَوْأَى (istawʔā) and اِسْتَوْءَى (istawʔā)
# اُسْتُوءُوا (ustūʔū) /us.tuː.ʔuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَوْأَى (istawʔā) and اِسْتَوْءَى (istawʔā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
